title: Improve search engine discoverability and add /build developer page
body:
## Summary

- Fix per-page canonical tags (previously all pages reported the root URL as canonical)
- Add explicit named AI bot directives to robots.txt for 12 major crawlers
- Add `<link rel="alternate">` headers pointing to machine-readable documentation files
- Add `SoftwareApplication` JSON-LD schema to homepage alongside existing `FAQPage`
- Fix download page schema: `operatingSystem` as array, `downloadUrl` array with both TestFlight and APK links, plus `codeRepository` and `license`
- Add `CollectionPage` + `ItemList` schema to blog index with XSS-safe serialization
- Add `WebPage` + `ItemList` schema to contribute page
- Add canonical tags to all remaining pages (download, contribute, privacy-matters, blog index, blog posts)
- Create `/build` developer documentation page with Marmot Protocol reference: MDK quick-start, crate structure, Nostr event kinds table, ciphersuite, identity model, client flow, MIP status, known limitations, TypeScript guide, key dependencies, and repository table
- Add "Build" nav link to header (desktop + mobile) and footer
- Add `/build` to XML sitemap
- Add `vercel.json` with `X-Robots-Tag` and `Link` response headers
- Update `llms.txt` with `/build` page references and promoted "Building with Marmot" section

## Test plan

- [ ] `npx svelte-check --threshold error` passes with 0 errors
- [ ] Visit each page and inspect `<head>` for correct canonical URL and JSON-LD schemas
- [ ] Verify `/build` renders with all sections (MDK crates, event kinds, MIP status, etc.)
- [ ] Verify "Build" link appears in header nav, mobile menu, and footer
- [ ] Verify `/sitemap.xml` includes `/build`
- [ ] Verify `/robots.txt` shows named bot blocks
- [ ] Verify `/llms.txt` references the new `/build` page
- [ ] Validate JSON-LD with Google Rich Results Test on homepage, download, blog index

<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
  * Added a "Build" nav link and a dedicated Build documentation page; exposed plaintext developer resources at /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt
  * Enhanced blog rendering to serve sanitized HTML for posts

* **Documentation**
  * Added canonical links and structured JSON-LD across pages (site, blog, FAQ, build, contribute, download)

* **Chores**
  * Updated robots/headers and sitemap to surface LLM-friendly resources and included the Build page; CI workflow and headers configured for site indexing
<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->

title: Add LLM and agent accessibility layer
body:
## Summary

- Add `llms.txt` and `llms-full.txt` for structured LLM context (follows the llms.txt standard)
- Add `robots.txt` welcoming all crawlers with sitemap reference
- Add `.well-known/security.txt` (RFC 9116) pointing to GitHub security advisories
- Add dynamic `sitemap.xml` server route that includes static pages and blog posts from Nostr
- Add JSON-LD structured data on every page (WebSite, Organization, FAQPage, SoftwareApplication, Article, BlogPosting)
- Fix `site.webmanifest` placeholder names ("MyWebSite" to "White Noise")

## Content and copy changes

- Standardize tagline: remove "truly" and "infinitely", use "A secure and private messenger that's lightning fast, scalable, and identity-free"
- Replace "seamlessly" with "automatically" and "with speed" in feature descriptions
- Replace unverified "groups with over 1,000 members" claim with accurate description of logarithmic MLS scaling
- Update GitHub links from parres-hq to marmot-protocol org
- Update Zapstore link to app-specific URL
- Update funding order to: And Other Stuff, OpenSats, Human Rights Foundation
- Add Blossom as third protocol in the Marmot stack (Nostr + Blossom + MLS)
- Add "Open & Decentralized" feature card reference to Marmot Protocol

## Developer documentation (in llms-full.txt)

- "Building with Marmot" section with MDK crate structure, quick start for Rust and TypeScript
- Nostr event kinds table (443, 444, 445, 447-449, 10050, 10051)
- Default ciphersuite, identity model, and 6-step basic client flow
- MIP status table (MIP-00 through MIP-05)
- Key dependencies table (OpenMLS, rust-nostr, Blossom)
- Complete Marmot Protocol ecosystem: all 5 repos with licenses

## Files changed

**New files (5):**
- `static/robots.txt`
- `static/llms.txt`
- `static/llms-full.txt`
- `static/.well-known/security.txt`
- `src/routes/sitemap.xml/+server.ts`

**Modified files (8):**
- `src/app.html` - tagline fix in meta descriptions
- `src/routes/+layout.svelte` - WebSite + Organization JSON-LD
- `src/routes/+page.svelte` - FAQPage JSON-LD, tagline, feature card, FAQ copy fixes
- `src/routes/blog/[naddr]/+page.svelte` - BlogPosting JSON-LD, OG meta tags
- `src/routes/contribute/+page.svelte` - GitHub link to marmot-protocol
- `src/routes/download/+page.svelte` - SoftwareApplication JSON-LD, tagline, APK link, Zapstore link
- `src/routes/privacy-matters/+page.svelte` - Article JSON-LD, added missing title and description meta
- `static/site.webmanifest` - fixed placeholder names and theme colors

## Test plan

- [ ] Verify `whitenoise.chat/llms.txt` returns valid Markdown
- [ ] Verify `whitenoise.chat/llms-full.txt` returns complete content
- [ ] Verify `whitenoise.chat/robots.txt` is accessible
- [ ] Verify `whitenoise.chat/.well-known/security.txt` is accessible
- [ ] Verify `whitenoise.chat/sitemap.xml` returns valid XML with blog posts
- [ ] Validate JSON-LD on each page using Google Rich Results Test
- [ ] Check all GitHub links resolve (marmot-protocol org)
- [ ] Verify no mentions of parres-hq in rendered pages

<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
  * Added sitemap generation, robots instructions, and a published security policy

* **Documentation**
  * Added comprehensive static developer/LLM reference documents

* **Improvements**
  * Enhanced SEO and social metadata (site, FAQs, blog posts, downloads, privacy)
  * Streamlined meta descriptions and hero wording
  * Updated app manifest and several external repository links
<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
